text:
maya: Hey — running into a weird module resolution failure when using pnpm workspaces + our JS SDK on Cloudflare Workers (edge). Error is `Cannot find module '/workspace/node_modules/.pnpm/..../@our-sdk'`. Works with npm install locally. Anyone seen `exports` + symlink/hoisting issues on edge runtimes?

oli: ugh yea this smells like pnpm's symlink layout + bundler resolver mismatch. Can you paste package.json `exports` from the SDK package? Also which bundler (wrangler, vite, webpack)?

maya: Using wrangler + esbuild for the worker. SDK package.json exports:```json
{
  "name": "@our-sdk",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "dist/index.mjs",
      "require": "dist/index.cjs.js",
      "types": "dist/index.d.ts"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  }
}
```

maya: The worker bundle ends up resolving to the physical pnpm store path which doesn't exist in the deployed environment. Locally it resolves fine because of the symlinks.

samir: Two things to try: 1) set `nodeLinker: node-modules` in .npmrc so pnpm creates a classic node_modules layout (no symlinks), or 2) make the SDK export a single ESM entry (remove cjs) and ensure the bundler consumes that.

linh: Also try `preserveSymlinks: true` for Node/Vite/esbuild? For bundlers, if symlinks are flattened during build, resolution for `exports` can break. In esbuild you can toggle `preserveSymlinks` via the Node resolver shim.

maya: tried nodeLinker=node-modules in CI and the deploy stopped failing, but we can't force customers to switch their pnpm config. Looking for a DX fix: either SDK-side or build-time shim.

oli: SDK-side fix: add an explicit top-level `exports: {"./*": "./dist/*.mjs"}`? Not exactly but you can add more granular exports so the bundler doesn't try to reach into node_modules internals. Also ensure `types` is a top-level export alias if TS users import subpaths.

samir: Another pattern that fixed us: ship a tiny ESM entry at the package root that re-exports internal files without relying on deep imports. e.g. `index.mjs` that does `export * from './dist/index.mjs'` and then have `exports: {".": "./index.mjs"}`. That keeps runtime resolution simple for edges.

linh: For TypeScript typings: some bundlers don't pick up `types` inside `exports`. Add a top-level `types` field in package.json (you already have it) but also ensure d.ts files are adjacent to the published package (not symlinked). pnpm sometimes hoists types into a different folder that tsc/bundlers miss.

maya: here's what finally worked for us (SDK changes):
1) publish a tiny root ESM shim `index.mjs` that imports the built ESM bundle and re-exports.
2) keep `exports` simple: `".": {"import":"./index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs.js"}`
3) include `types` as top-level pointing to `dist/index.d.ts` and ensure dist is packaged.

maya: After that, Cloudflare bundle resolves cleanly even when consuming workspace symlinks. We still recommend nodeLinker=node-modules for CI in monorepos, but SDK change reduced customer friction.

oli: Nice. Can we add a short troubleshooting note in devex docs: pnpm + edge runtimes -> prefer root ESM shim + simple exports, or use nodeLinker=node-modules?

devex-bot: Added a TODO card to the devex backlog: "SDK: add root ESM shim + simplify exports to improve pnpm/workspace edge compatibility" :white_check_mark:

samir: Also add a test in our sample app repo that runs a Cloudflare bundle build with a pnpm workspace layout to catch regressions.

maya: on it — I'll open a PR with the SDK shim + docs and add the sample-app CI job. Thanks all :sparkles:
